title: Olunaku lw'okwolesebwa okusembayo
intro: Nga bayitiddwa okwolesebwa okw’amaanyi okw’amaanyi, ekibinja ky’abayimbi abakugu beesanga nga boolekedde amazima ge baali batasuubira, agaali gagenda okukyusa obulamu bwabwe emirembe gyonna.
clues: Twali tumanyiddwa nnyo olw’emirimu gyaffe egy’emikono, abakugu mu by’okwefuula n’obukodyo.
Twayitibwa omufuzi okutunuulira omuvuganya eyali akwata omuggo omungu.
Bwe twalaba amazima, twagwa wansi mu kuvunnama, nga tulangirira okukkiriza mu Mukama w’ensi.
Omutyobooli oyo yatutiisatiisa okubonerezebwa okw’amaanyi, naye tetwawuguka.
Twali bamu ku baasooka okukkiriza obubaka obwo oluvannyuma lw’okulaba akabonero akategeerekeka obulungi.
Twattibwa olw’okukkiriza kwaffe, naye ffe tujja kusooka okuyingira ejjana n’abatuukirivu.
arabic: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًۭا قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَـٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ
verse: So the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, "We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses." (20:70)
